thread:
maria: Quick question — for the new console UI showing quota bands by token type, do we want to surface service-account impersonation separately or roll it into the project bucket?
ben: I'd vote separate. impersonation skews attribution. harder to debug if mixed.
aj: separate + show lineage (orig_project -> impersonated_sa). otherwise billing + alerts get noisy. :+1:
maria: Agreed. UX ask: can the console show both 'effective project' and 'auth path' (like: org/a -> proj/x -> sa:billing)? even if it's a single column?
kevin: Technically we already emit auth_path in telemetry, but the sampling rate for large tenants is low. need to bump sampling for SA impersonation events.
ben: Telemetry names we should standardize: auth_request_total{auth_method="api_key|sa_impersonation|token_exchange", route="hosted|dedicated"}. Also add label orig_project and effective_project.
aj: +1. Also add label token_type="ephemeral|long_lived" so rateband chart can show bursts from ephemeral proxies.
maria: Rollout plan? I think feature-flag the UI first, expose a backend bool that toggles including impersonation rows. start canary 5% orgs.
kevin: Ops note: when flag on, increase auth_path sampling from 1% -> 10% for canary orgs. remember storage costs. maybe keep retention for those traces shorter.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/sa-auth-path-telemetry -> staging (sha: a1b2c3). ETA 15m.
maria: After staging smoke, schedule 1-hour canary window with SLO dashboard pinned. if we see billing-affinity errors, roll back.
ben: Also add a help tooltip: "Why do I see sa:billing attributed to project x?" that links to docs explaining impersonation and quota attribution. keeps support slf down.
aj: I'll draft telemetry dashboards queries. example: `sum(rate(auth_request_total{auth_method="sa_impersonation"}[5m])) by (effective_project, route)`
maria: Perfect. thanks everyone — will follow up with flag rollout doc + PR link.
